programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: A young African-American photographer visits his white girlfriend's family estate for the weekend. What begins as awkward racial tension quickly devolves into a sinister conspiracy as he uncovers a horrifying secret about why he was really invited and fights to escape.

programme.title: Girl
programme.desc: A young woman returns to her small hometown with intent to kill her abusive father, only to discover someone murdered him the day before. She becomes embroiled in dark family secrets and finds herself prey to a sinister sheriff while seeking truth and revenge.

programme.title: Midsommar
programme.desc: A couple travels to Sweden for a midsummer festival in a remote village. What begins as an idyllic pastoral retreat quickly devolves into a disturbing pagan cult ritual. As the relationship fractures, the boyfriend disappears and his girlfriend becomes dangerously entangled in ancient traditions.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: After the death of her secretive mother, Annie Graham and her family begin unraveling cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry. As disturbing occurrences escalate, they discover a sinister fate they've inherited and struggle against descending into madness.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: The Wilson family vacations at their beach house in Santa Cruz, but their serenity turns to terror when mysterious doppelgängers appear at their door. Adelaide and her family discover these red jumpsuit-clad duplicates, called "the Tethered," are exact copies seeking to kill their counterparts as part of a nationwide uprising forming a disturbing human chain.

programme.title: Spree
programme.desc: Kurt is a young rideshare driver so desperate for social media attention and viral fame that he livestreams a murderous rampage. Documenting everything through dashcams and phones, he embarks on a killing spree, targeting passengers in a disturbing satire of influencer culture.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: A quiet drifter finds himself stranded in a remote town. Unable to pay for car repairs, he agrees to spend the night cleaning an abandoned family entertainment center. He soon discovers the animatronic characters come murderously alive, and he must fight them off without speaking a word.

programme.title: 47 Meters Down
programme.desc: Two adventurous sisters vacation in Mexico and dive underwater in a steel shark cage to swim with great white sharks. When their cage breaks away from the boat and plunges to the ocean floor, their oxygen runs low and they must face the deadly predators in a desperate fight for survival.

programme.title: Dismissed
programme.desc: An idealistic English teacher is drawn into a nightmare when a brilliant but psychotic honors student receives a B+ grade. The student launches a ruthless campaign of psychological manipulation and terror, willing to do anything to achieve academic perfection and destroy his teacher's life.

programme.title: Fear the Night
programme.desc: Iraq War veteran and recovering alcoholic Tess attends her sister's bachelorette party at a remote farmhouse. When masked intruders launch a brutal home invasion, Tess must use her military training to protect the group and fight for their survival against overwhelming odds.

programme.title: Octopus Pot
programme.desc: A broken man and hitman finds the one thing he can't live without, only to lose it tragically. Unable to bring back the woman he loves, he embarks on a violent path of vengeance, covering the ground with the blood of his enemies while suffering from broken heart syndrome.

programme.title: Off The Menu
programme.desc: An unlikely heir to a Mexican fast-food franchise goes searching for culinary innovation and discovers a small New Mexican town. There he meets a feisty female chef whose authentic cooking and passionate approach to food challenges everything he knows about his family business.

programme.title: Primal Rage
programme.desc: A newly reunited couple's drive through the Pacific Northwest turns into a nightmare when they encounter a monstrous creature known to Native Americans as Oh-Mah (Bigfoot). Stranded in the woods with unsavory locals, they must fight for survival against the legendary beast.

programme.title: Red Snow
programme.desc: A struggling vampire romance novelist in Lake Tahoe nurtures an injured bat back to health during Christmas, only to discover it's actually a handsome vampire. When a vampire hunter and more vampires arrive, she must defend her home and unexpected guest in this darkly comedic horror.

programme.desc: Working-class African-American father Troy Maxson tries to raise his family in 1950s Pittsburgh while coming to terms with events of his life. A former baseball player denied opportunity due to racism, he struggles with resentment, marital strife, and relationships with his sons.

programme.desc: Three high school freshmen hire a low-budget bodyguard to protect them from bullies. The man claiming to be a special ops veteran is actually a homeless con artist, but he develops genuine affection for the kids while teaching them to stand up for themselves.

programme.desc: Film noir-obsessed video store clerk Neil meets and falls for Violet, a free-spirited woman who pulls him into her world of spontaneous adventures. She stages elaborate film-like scenarios to shake up his routine life, but her extreme methods test whether their romance can survive reality.

programme.title: Two Can Play That Game
programme.desc: Corporate attorney and relationship expert Shante Smith uses her rules for romance to keep her boyfriend in line. When he threatens to stray, she employs her ten-day plan to regain control, but his best friend counters with his own dating strategies in this battle of sexes.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Best friends Sidney and Dre share a lifelong love of hip-hop music. As they navigate their careers in the music industry—she as a magazine editor, he as a record executive—they must confront whether their deep connection is just friendship or something more romantic.

programme.title: All About The Benjamins
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Bucum Jackson teams with small-time con artist Reggie Wright, the man he's been pursuing, to locate missing diamonds and a lottery ticket worth millions. The unlikely partners race against criminals in this action-comedy about money, survival, and unexpected friendship.

programme.title: 500 Days of Summer
programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Tom Hansen works at a greeting card company and falls for Summer, a woman who doesn't believe in true love. The nonlinear narrative follows 500 days of their relationship as Tom reflects on where things went wrong after she unexpectedly dumps him.

programme.desc: Based on the true story of Oscar Grant's last day, January 1, 2009. The 22-year-old Bay Area resident celebrates New Year's Eve with family and friends before a confrontation with police at Fruitvale BART station leads to his tragic death, sparking national outrage.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Based on a true story, professor Melvin B. Tolson inspires students at historically black Wiley College to form a debate team in 1930s Texas. They challenge racial prejudice and inequality, ultimately competing against Harvard University in a groundbreaking championship match.

programme.title: Love & Basketball

programme.title: Lords of Chaos
programme.desc: Based on true events, the film chronicles the rise of Norwegian black metal music scene in the early 1990s. Young musicians form bands that descend into church burnings, violence, and murder, with tragic consequences for the underground music community.

programme.desc: Margot, a happily married woman, develops an intense attraction to her charming neighbor Daniel. She struggles between comfortable marriage and passionate desire, exploring themes of commitment, longing, and whether giving in to temptation will bring happiness or destroy everything.

programme.title: Mr. 3000
programme.desc: Aging baseball legend Stan Ross discovers that three of his 3,000 career hits were incorrectly counted. Nine years after retiring, the arrogant player returns to baseball at age 47 to reclaim his record and legacy while learning humility and what truly matters.

programme.title: Baby Boy
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Jody lives with his mother while fathering children with two different women. That's when a gunshot rings out in the night and the three meet Remington. Now they all must battle for their lives against the evil that pursues Remington to once and for all lock the evil away for good...

programme.title: Jack and Jill: The Hills of Hell

The trail leads her to Timere, a remote place far from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, where amidst the tight lipped silence of the town's inhabitants there's an ever growing fear of dark forces at work and no-one dares to leave their home at night. Here Rebecca meets an extravagant writer, the church warden of the town and above all Caleb, a charming, rich and elegant man whose dark gaze hides a chilling secret. It's in this town, where time appears to move between the shadows and danger lurks around every corner that Rebecca learns of the terrible truth and the battle between good and evil begins...

programme.title: Demon Baby

programme.title: The Last Nosferatu

One night, he dates “Black Pearl” whom he literally falls in love with, but she disappears, so he decides to go looking for her. One evening, Black Pearl resurfaces and seems to be hiding a mysterious secret that will lead him to a tragic fate...

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: After his daughter goes missing, a wealthy contractor hires a group of investigative journalists to probe into an abandoned town with hope of uncovering clues about her disappearance...

programme.title: Early Grave
programme.desc: On the eve of their ten year high school reunion, six people are summoned to the isolated country estate of one of their former friends, now a famous horror writer. Once there, separated by guilt, yet bound together by a terrible secret, seven adults try to reconnect with each other, and take stock of their lives. Outside, the storm clouds gather. Rain, lightning and wind isolate the house by washing out the road and knocking down the power lines. And then, they begin to be brutally murdered one by one. Someone is out there in the wind and the rain, someone who has waited for ten years to wreak a terrible vengeance on this group. Seven friends find themselves in a struggle to survive and outwit a diabolical killer who is savagely committed to sending them all to an EARLY GRAVE...

If they thought that this trip was going to be smooth sailing, they soon realized how mistaken they were when Don hit them with the hardest physical evolution in Surviving Mann’s history.

Who will win and prove their water proficiency?
